title: EEG: First Episode Psychosis vs. Control Resting Task 1
description: Resting-state EEG recordings from healthy controls and individuals with first episode psychosis (FEP), representing the first of two independently collected samples. The dataset includes 5-minute resting recordings with a 60-channel 10-10 cap, plus phenotype data covering clinical, cognitive, and socioeconomic assessments. It supports investigation of resting-state cortical abnormalities in the early schizophrenia spectrum.
methods_description: Resting EEG was recorded for 5 minutes using an Elekta Neuromag Vectorview system with a low-impedance 60-channel 10-10 system cap. Clinical assessments included BPRS, SANS, SAPS, GAF/GAS, SFS, MATRICS, WASI, Hollingshead index, and chlorpromazine-equivalent medication doses.
